description: This file defines the BufferStream class, a PHP implementation of a stream interface in the GuzzleHttp library. It provides buffer management with read/write capabilities, high water mark handling, and stream metadata.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: Implements a buffer stream with customizable high water mark, supporting read and write operations, but disallowing seeking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes BufferStream with an optional high water mark.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire contents of the buffer as a string.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves all remaining buffer data and clears the buffer.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the stream and returns null.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer in bytes.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Always returns true; the buffer is always readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Always returns true; the buffer is always writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Always returns false; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the pointer to the beginning by calling seek(0).

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException as seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException as position cannot be determined.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer and returns 0 if buffer exceeds high water mark.
